summary.text: Bert Anderson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 2 (Crosby) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Bert Anderson's service as "House since 2015". The member page lists Bert Anderson's committee assignments as including the Appropriations standing committee.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Bert Anderson's occupation as Business Owner.
It lists education as Lake Region College.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Mayor of Crosby; Crosby City Council; Board, St. Luke’s Hospital; Crosby Assembly of God.
Bert Anderson is listed as married to Diane with 2 children and 4 grandchildren.
